be0197e31b4525dba6de8041ec0a959b.overview: A revenge-seeking gold digger marries a womanizing Beverly Hills lawyer with the intention of making a killing in the divorce.

be17fbf4d4cd0fb4ab6191f1d4c06a0e.overview: An unflinching, fragmentary look at a handful of self-destructive, marginalized people, but taking as main focus the heroin-addicted Vanda Duarte.

be2a878e174e9eca47935a0a6d3a71dc.overview: A young social climber wins the heart of a beautiful heiress but his former girlfriend's pregnancy stands in the way of his ambition.
be2a878e174e9eca47935a0a6d3a71dc.tagline: Young people asking so much of life... taking so much of love!

be4d62553c6a71544fdaf8fd17b9fc1d.overview: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

be79fd64e5f7257f99d529f638e2be1f.overview: In the years before World War II, a tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey is hired as a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children and brings a new love of life and music into the home.
be79fd64e5f7257f99d529f638e2be1f.tagline: The happiest sound in all the world!

be8203d73aefe3b15a27218476d3ba98.overview: On her first anniversary, Ann Reagan finds that her sister-in-law is involved with a shady character that she used to be intimate with, and determines to intervene.
be8203d73aefe3b15a27218476d3ba98.tagline: A drama of sacrifice and supreme love

be9e78b16738abe4f4b526493f1ff211.overview: A Serbian émigré in Manhattan believes that, because of an ancient curse, any physical intimacy with the man she loves will turn her into a feline predator.
be9e78b16738abe4f4b526493f1ff211.tagline: She knew strange, fierce pleasures that no other woman could ever feel!

bed3218bddd9f24595d680cbd1641687.overview: Story of a young woman who marries a fascinating widower only to find out that she must live in the shadow of his former wife, Rebecca, who died mysteriously several years earlier. The young wife must come to grips with the terrible secret of her handsome, cold husband, Max De Winter. She must also deal with the jealous, obsessed Mrs. Danvers, the housekeeper, who will not accept her as the mistress of the house.
bed3218bddd9f24595d680cbd1641687.tagline: "Last night I dreamt I went to Manderley again..."
